description:
Documentation, guides, and the LiveView interop adapter. Opens after all four Track H
test suites are green on CI.

  I1 — HexDocs foundation
       All public modules documented with @moduledoc/@doc/@spec. dialyzer clean.
       mix docs generates without errors. Required before any guide work.

  I2 — Guide: "Getting Started"
       Fills in guides/Getting Started.md. Walks through the TodoList example
       (G1): defcomponent, props, use_state, event closures, keyed list, rung-2 test.

  I3 — Guide: "Observables"
       Fills in guides/Observables.md. Walks through the Cart example (G2):
       Observable.GenServer, use_observable, projections, change-or-bust,
       two-projection demo (CartBadge vs CartView), rung-3 test.

  I4 — Guide: "Resource Holds"
       Fills in guides/Resource Holds.md. Walks through the Inventory example (G3):
       Hold.GenServer, use_hold, :DOWN → release lifecycle, out-of-stock UX,
       process-death test. Includes Collaboration example as an advanced aside.

  I5 — LiveView interop adapter
       Filament.LiveComponent: embed a Filament component subtree inside a regular
       Phoenix LiveView as a Phoenix.LiveComponent. One direction only (Filament
       inside LiveView). The reverse (Filament hosting a LiveComponent) is Phase 2.

  I6 — Migration guide
       Fills in guides/Migration Guide.md. Phased codemods for lifting LiveView
       assigns into GenServer + Filament observables. References I2–I4 guides.

Prerequisites (all must be merged before any I ticket can start):
  Track H (flm-yj9) — all four test suites passing on CI.
  This implies Track G (examples), Track F (test harness), and all upstream tracks.

Dependency order within Track I:
  I1 → I2, I3, I4, I5 (parallel)
  I2 + I3 + I4 → I6

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html §02 Track I section
title: Track I: Docs & Interop — HexDocs, narrative guides, LiveView interop adapter
